_readme: Single source of truth for the shop. Values from GVP-PRICE-01 (Researcher, 8 Oct 2026), IDR column, adopted by the team. IDR ONLY: Bank Indonesia bans dual quotation (PBI 17/3/2015 art. 11, SEBI 17/11/DKSP), so no other currency may be shown, stored for display or toggled on public pages. Launch defaults approved by Barrie on 8 Oct 2026: prices and cart ON for clients outside Indonesia; clients based in Indonesia are confirmed offline with bilingual engagement terms until the Indonesian terms are published. No standalone digital-product SKUs: digital materials may only appear as included items inside a package. No was-prices, no countdowns. Schema is documented in the conversion-pass-2 brief.

flags._note: indonesiaCheckoutReady stays false until the Indonesian terms (/id/terms/) are reviewed and published. While false, buyers based in Indonesia see the same IDR prices but are asked to book a call or request a quote, and their order is confirmed offline with bilingual engagement terms.

currencies._note: IDR only. English pages show amounts as the invoice states them: "IDR 20 million", "IDR 12.5 million", "IDR 2.4 billion", falling back to "IDR 12,345,678". Bahasa pages show Rp20.000.000. Do not add a second currency.

payment._note: Launch payment: invoice from PT Grand Vision Perspective in IDR, paid by bank transfer to the company's Indonesian account. Never name the bank on the site. No VAT/PPN line (non-PKP). Clients whose business address is outside Indonesia may ask for a written quote with a rounded foreign-currency reference at the BI JISDOR rate for the quote date; the IDR amount is binding and every invoice is in IDR (offline, never on the site).

rules.offerTextId: Harga klien pendiri: diskon 15% untuk Operations Audit, Rp38.250.000, bukan Rp45.000.000, untuk 3 klien audit pertama kami atau sampai 31 Des 2026, mana yang lebih dulu. Tidak dapat digabung dengan diskon lain.
rules._note: Legal ruling 8 Oct 2026 13:50 WITA (UU 8/1999 art. 9 and 10). Discount, not a credit. Price: IDR 45,000,000 less 15% = IDR 38,250,000 (Rp38.250.000 on Bahasa pages). Limits: first 3 audit clients or until 31 Dec 2026, whichever comes first (when.endDate 2026-12-31). Not combined with other discounts (group one-discount-per-order). 'remaining' is the real count of founding places, never shown publicly: lower it by hand after each founding sale; at 0 the offer and the box disappear. Take the box down after 31 Dec 2026 even if places remain. No countdown and no places-left text. offerTextId is the Bahasa copy [BAHASA REVIEW NEEDED].

notes.text: Go ahead with an Implementation Oversight project of IDR 90 million or more within 30 days of receiving your report and the full audit fee is credited against it. You keep the report either way. The credit does not combine with other offers.
Book a full Operations Audit within 30 days and the Focus Audit fee is credited against it. The credit does not apply to projects, retainers or advisory work.

If the audit report identifies estimated annual time and cost savings, valued using the method stated in the report, below the audit fee paid, the client may claim a refund of 50% of the audit fee by written request within 14 days of report delivery. This guarantee does not apply where the client did not provide the access, data or staff time agreed in the engagement terms. One claim per client.
notes._note: Legal's wording, verbatim (8 Oct 2026), plus 'One claim per client.' Shown only when pricesPublished is true.
